```{r}
classic_did_z_all_ci <- c(unlist(map(classic_did_plot_data_all_z, ~.x$ci_lower)),
                          unlist(map(classic_did_plot_data_all_z, ~.x$ci_upper)))
classic_did_z_ylim <- c(min(classic_did_z_all_ci, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.05, max(classic_did_z_all_ci, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05)
classic_did_z_ylim <- c(-max(abs(classic_did_z_ylim)), max(abs(classic_did_z_ylim)))

classic_did_panels_z <- pmap(list(classic_did_plot_data_all_z, outcome_labels_figures, outcome_ylabs_figures), function(dat, label, ylab) {

    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +

    )) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(
      "Control (1-2 children)"   = 16,
      "Treatment (3+ children)"  = 15
    ), labels = c(
      "Control (1-2 children)"   = "1-2 children (control)",
      "Treatment (3+ children)"  = "3+ children"
    )) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = classic_did_z_ylim) +
    labs(title = label, x = "", y = ylab,
         colour = "Group", shape = "Group") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      legend.position  = "none",
      axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 7),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
})

classic_did_ordered_z <- classic_did_panels_z[display_order]

classic_did_combined_z <- (classic_did_ordered_z[[1]] | classic_did_ordered_z[[2]] | classic_did_ordered_z[[3]] | classic_did_ordered_z[[4]]) /
```

figures above, for a raw and standardised version each of the total DiD
plots.

## Controlled Interupted Time Series (CITS)

Finally, the CITS analyses will have a similar setup to the ITS
analyses, except that a for-loop is being used here instead of
`lapply()` because of memory capacity (approximately 68k observations
per imputed dataset, with 20 imputed datasets, and 8-18 terms per model
in CITS).

### Full models

These follow the same patterns as before, with unadjusted (raw),
adjusted (raw), and standardised adjusted models.

#### Unadjusted (raw outcomes)

**Psychological distress**
```{r}
#| label: ghq-total-5
# GHQ_total
cits_GHQ_full_unadj <- vector("list", imp_no2017$m)
```

(same structure as ITS/DiD workbooks)

```{r}
#| label: cits-excel-export

```

```{r}
#| label: unadjusted-raw-2
# unadjusted (raw)
addWorksheet(wb_cits, "CITS_Full_Unadj")
cits_tab_unadj <- bind_rows(
  summary(pooled_cits_GHQ_full_unadj, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.90) %>% mutate(outcome = "Ghq Total"),
  summary(pooled_cits_SF_full_unadj, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.90) %>% mutate(outcome = "Sf Total"),
  summary(pooled_cits_general_health_full_unadj, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.90) %>% mutate(outcome = "General Health"),
  summary(pooled_cits_health_sat_full_unadj, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.90) %>% mutate(outcome = "Health Sat"),
  summary(pooled_cits_life_sat_full_unadj, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.90) %>% mutate(outcome = "Life Sat"),
  summary(pooled_cits_finnow_full_unadj, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.90) %>% mutate(outcome = "Finnow"),
  summary(pooled_cits_finfut_full_unadj, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.90) %>% mutate(outcome = "Finfut")
)
writeData(wb_cits, "CITS_Full_Unadj", cits_tab_unadj)
```

#### Figure generation

For these figures, I will have the same structure as for all the figures
created above, with a raw and standardised version - this is building
off of the ITS code used above, just adding structure for the control
1-2 children group.

```{r}
#| label: helper-build-pooled-observed-means-for-c
# helper: build pooled observed means for CITS (both groups)
build_cits_plot_data <- function(outcome_var, data_long) {
  data_long %>%
    filter(.imp > 0) %>%
    group_by(.imp, intyear, family_3plus) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_val = mean(.data[[outcome_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(intyear, family_3plus) %>%
    summarise(
      pooled_mean = mean(mean_val),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(intyear != 2017) %>%
    mutate(
      post  = as.integer(intyear > 2017),
      group = ifelse(family_3plus == 0, "Control (1-2 children)", "3+ children")
    )
}

# helper: compute covariate contribution for CITS model
compute_cov_contribution_cits <- function(pooled_model, imp_data_long) {
  cits_terms <- c("(Intercept)", "time_since_policy", "post_policy_month", "family_3plus",
                  "time_since_policy:post_policy_month", "time_since_policy:family_3plus",
                  "post_policy_month:family_3plus", "time_since_policy:post_policy_month:family_3plus")
  all_coefs <- summary(pooled_model) %>% select(term, estimate)
  cov_coefs <- all_coefs %>% filter(!term %in% cits_terms)
  
  if (nrow(cov_coefs) == 0) return(0)
  
  cov_names_in_data <- c("age", "sex", "ethn_binary", "ukborn", "urban",
                         "edu_qual", "marstat", "equiv_yearly", "oc_current", "chron_health")
  
  cov_means <- imp_data_long %>%
    filter(.imp > 0, !(family_3plus == 1 & third_child_yob == 2017)) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(cov_names_in_data), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "term", values_to = "mean_val")
  
  contribution <- cov_coefs %>%
    left_join(cov_means, by = "term") %>%
    mutate(contrib = ifelse(!is.na(mean_val), estimate * mean_val, 0)) %>%
    pull(contrib) %>%
    sum(na.rm = TRUE)
  
  contribution
}

# helper: make CITS panel
make_cits_panel <- function(plot_data, pooled_model, outcome_label, outcome_ylab, imp_data_long) {
  
  coefs <- summary(pooled_model) %>% select(term, estimate)
  b0  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "(Intercept)"]
  b1  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "time_since_policy"]
  b2  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "post_policy_month"]
  b3  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "family_3plus"]
  b4  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "time_since_policy:post_policy_month"]
  b5  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "time_since_policy:family_3plus"]
  b6  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "post_policy_month:family_3plus"]
  b7  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "time_since_policy:post_policy_month:family_3plus"]
  
  cov_offset <- compute_cov_contribution_cits(pooled_model, imp_data_long)
  
  yr_min <- min(plot_data$intyear)
  yr_max <- max(plot_data$intyear)
  pre_years  <- seq(yr_min, 2016)
  post_years <- seq(2018, yr_max)
  pre_t  <- pre_years - 2017
  post_t <- post_years - 2017
  
  # control group fitted lines (pre and post)
  ctrl_pre  <- data.frame(year = pre_years,  y = b0 + b1 * pre_t + cov_offset, group = "1-2 children (control)")
  ctrl_post <- data.frame(year = post_years, y = b0 + b1 * post_t + b2 + b4 * post_t + cov_offset, group = "1-2 children (control)")
  
  # treatment group fitted lines (pre and post)
  trt_pre  <- data.frame(year = pre_years,  y = b0 + b1 * pre_t + b3 + b5 * pre_t + cov_offset, group = "3+ children")
  trt_post <- data.frame(year = post_years, y = b0 + b1 * post_t + b3 + b5 * post_t + b2 + b4 * post_t + b6 + b7 * post_t + cov_offset, group = "3+ children")
  
  fitted_lines <- bind_rows(ctrl_pre, ctrl_post, trt_pre, trt_post)
  
  # remap observed data group labels
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(group = case_when(
      group == "Control (1-2 children)" ~ "1-2 children (control)",
      group == "3+ children" ~ "3+ children",
      TRUE ~ group
    ))
  
  ggplot() +
    # observed means as transparent dots
    geom_point(data = plot_data,
               aes(x = intyear, y = pooled_mean, colour = group),
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) +
    # fitted trend lines (both groups)
    geom_line(data = fitted_lines,
              aes(x = year, y = y, colour = group),
              linewidth = 1.1) +
    # policy line
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2017, colour = "#D55E00",
               linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      "1-2 children (control)" = "#E69F00",
      "3+ children"            = "#0072B2"
    )) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(yr_min, yr_max, by = 2)) +
    labs(title = outcome_label, x = "", y = outcome_ylab,
         colour = "Group") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.position  = "none",
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# list of adjusted CITS pooled models
cits_adj_pooled_models <- list(
  pooled_cits_GHQ_full_adj,
  pooled_cits_SF_full_adj,
  pooled_cits_general_health_full_adj,
  pooled_cits_health_sat_full_adj,
  pooled_cits_life_sat_full_adj,
  pooled_cits_finnow_full_adj,
  pooled_cits_finfut_full_adj
)

# build plot data and panels
cits_plot_data_all <- map(outcomes_raw, ~build_cits_plot_data(.x, imp_long_no2017))

# generate individual panels with figure labels
cits_panels <- pmap(list(seq_along(outcomes_raw), outcome_labels_figures, outcome_ylabs_figures), function(j, label, ylab) {
  make_cits_panel(cits_plot_data_all[[j]], cits_adj_pooled_models[[j]], label, ylab, imp_long_no2017)
})

# custom CITS legend with policy line and consistent order
cits_legend_source <- ggplot() +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1.5, colour = "Two-child benefit cap\nintroduction (2017)"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(x = 1, y = 1, colour = "3+ children"), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(x = c(1, 2), y = c(1, 2), colour = "3+ children"), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(x = 1, y = 1, colour = "1-2 children (control)"), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(x = c(1, 2), y = c(1, 2), colour = "1-2 children (control)"), linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "",
    values = c("Two-child benefit cap\nintroduction (2017)" = "#D55E00",
               "3+ children" = "#0072B2",
               "1-2 children (control)" = "#E69F00"),
    breaks = c("Two-child benefit cap\nintroduction (2017)", "3+ children", "1-2 children (control)"),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
      shape    = c(NA, 16, 16),
      linetype = c("dashed", "solid", "solid"),
      linewidth = c(0.8, 1.1, 1.1),
      alpha    = c(1, 1, 1)
    ))
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "center", legend.text = element_text(size = 8))

cits_legend   <- make_legend_panel(cits_legend_source)
cits_legend_z <- cits_legend

# reorder and assemble with legend as 8th panel
cits_ordered <- cits_panels[display_order]

cits_combined <- (cits_ordered[[1]] | cits_ordered[[2]] | cits_ordered[[3]] | cits_ordered[[4]]) /
  (cits_ordered[[5]] | cits_ordered[[6]] | cits_ordered[[7]] | cits_legend) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Changes in parental outcomes for those with 3+ children compared to 1-2 children",
    subtitle = "Marginal means shown. Higher scores indicate worse outcomes.",
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  )

pdf("output/CITS_all_outcomes_multipanel_20260330.pdf", width = 16, height = 9)
print(cits_combined)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#| label: list-of-z-score-adjusted-cits-pooled-mod
# list of z-score adjusted CITS pooled models
cits_adj_z_pooled_models <- list(
  pooled_cits_GHQ_full_adj_z,
  pooled_cits_SF_full_adj_z,
  pooled_cits_general_health_full_adj_z,
  pooled_cits_health_sat_full_adj_z,
  pooled_cits_life_sat_full_adj_z,
  pooled_cits_finnow_full_adj_z,
  pooled_cits_finfut_full_adj_z
)

# build z-scored plot data
cits_plot_data_all_z <- map(outcomes_z_names, ~build_cits_plot_data(.x, imp_long_no2017))

# auto-calculate shared symmetric y-axis range across all z-scored CITS panels
cits_z_all_means <- unlist(map(cits_plot_data_all_z, ~.x$pooled_mean))
cits_z_ylim <- c(min(cits_z_all_means, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.15, max(cits_z_all_means, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.15)
# make symmetric around 0
cits_z_ylim <- c(-max(abs(cits_z_ylim)), max(abs(cits_z_ylim)))

# helper: make CITS panel (z-score version, shared y-axis)
make_cits_panel_z <- function(plot_data, pooled_model, outcome_label, outcome_ylab, imp_data_long, shared_ylim) {
  
  coefs <- summary(pooled_model) %>% select(term, estimate)
  b0  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "(Intercept)"]
  b1  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "time_since_policy"]
  b2  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "post_policy_month"]
  b3  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "family_3plus"]
  b4  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "time_since_policy:post_policy_month"]
  b5  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "time_since_policy:family_3plus"]
  b6  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "post_policy_month:family_3plus"]
  b7  <- coefs$estimate[coefs$term == "time_since_policy:post_policy_month:family_3plus"]
  
  cov_offset <- compute_cov_contribution_cits(pooled_model, imp_data_long)
  
  yr_min <- min(plot_data$intyear)
  yr_max <- max(plot_data$intyear)
  pre_years  <- seq(yr_min, 2016)
  post_years <- seq(2018, yr_max)
  pre_t  <- pre_years - 2017
  post_t <- post_years - 2017
  
  # control group fitted lines (pre and post)
  ctrl_pre  <- data.frame(year = pre_years,  y = b0 + b1 * pre_t + cov_offset, group = "1-2 children (control)")
  ctrl_post <- data.frame(year = post_years, y = b0 + b1 * post_t + b2 + b4 * post_t + cov_offset, group = "1-2 children (control)")
  
  # treatment group fitted lines (pre and post)
  trt_pre  <- data.frame(year = pre_years,  y = b0 + b1 * pre_t + b3 + b5 * pre_t + cov_offset, group = "3+ children")
  trt_post <- data.frame(year = post_years, y = b0 + b1 * post_t + b3 + b5 * post_t + b2 + b4 * post_t + b6 + b7 * post_t + cov_offset, group = "3+ children")
  
  fitted_lines <- bind_rows(ctrl_pre, ctrl_post, trt_pre, trt_post)
  
  # remap observed data group labels
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(group = case_when(
      group == "Control (1-2 children)" ~ "1-2 children (control)",
      group == "3+ children" ~ "3+ children",
      TRUE ~ group
    ))
  
  ggplot() +
    # zero reference line
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dotted") +
    # observed means as transparent dots
    geom_point(data = plot_data,
               aes(x = intyear, y = pooled_mean, colour = group),
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) +
    # fitted trend lines (both groups)
    geom_line(data = fitted_lines,
              aes(x = year, y = y, colour = group),
              linewidth = 1.1) +
    # policy line
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2017, colour = "#D55E00",
               linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      "1-2 children (control)" = "#E69F00",
      "3+ children"            = "#0072B2"
    )) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(yr_min, yr_max, by = 2)) +
    # shared y-axis across all panels, symmetric around 0
    coord_cartesian(ylim = shared_ylim) +
    labs(title = outcome_label, x = "", y = outcome_ylab,
         colour = "Group") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.position  = "none",
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# generate z-score CITS panels
cits_panels_z <- pmap(list(seq_along(outcomes_raw), outcome_labels_figures, outcome_ylabs_figures), function(j, label, ylab) {
  make_cits_panel_z(cits_plot_data_all_z[[j]], cits_adj_z_pooled_models[[j]], label, ylab, imp_long_no2017, cits_z_ylim)
})

  plot_annotation(

    subtitle = "Marginal means on standardised scale from controlled interrupted time series models shown. Higher scores indicate worse outcomes.",
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  )

pdf("output/CITS_all_outcomes_multipanel_zscore_20260330.pdf", width = 16, height = 9)
```
